STORY The story

RECOLLECTION

Veteran Remarque lies in a hospital bed. His grandson Anderson brings a faded photo from his army days. It wakes memories of the commander once famous for interception and wiretapping. As he tells his grandson the story of his war, everything begins again on the day he was first assigned to the 5th Infantry Division at the front.

CHARACTER 01

Remarque REMARQUE

A commander once renowned for interception and wiretapping. After retiring, his health declined; from his hospital bed he recounts his war to his grandson. The narrator of this story.

CHARACTER 02

Anderson ANDERSON

Remarque's grandson. A listener drawn to his grandfather's army stories — the one who opens the door to memory.

CHARACTER 03

Nick Carraway NICK CARRAWAY

Warrant officer of the 109th Infantry Division. Stayed by Major Remarque's side to help him adapt to the battlefield on his first real deployment.

TRANSMISSION 04FREQ 09.40 MHz

SIGNAL LOOP Core loop

FIELD MANUAL
  1. 01

    Intercept & gather INTERCEPT

    When interception begins, the decoder turns enemy Morse into letters one by one. You take dictation of the decoded content with Tap.

  2. 02

    Analyze intel ANALYZE

    Interpret the intercepted messages to read the enemy's next move, contact time and frequency.

  3. 03

    Send orders COMMAND

    Using the Morse chart, transmit orders based on what you learned — move allied units or order attacks.

  4. 04

    Prepare the next tune TUNE

    Enter the next frequency and time on the radio and clock. Get it wrong and the interception fails; missed intel only partly appears in the intel log.

FIELD REPORT Features & units

KEY FEATURES

FEATURE 01

Combat built on cryptography

Moving beyond combat-first play, the game stresses information warfare. Decode signals quickly and accurately to grasp enemy intent and control your ground forces efficiently.

FEATURE 02

Morse send & receive

Allied orders and enemy intercepts arrive as Morse code, not plain text. Decoding an unfamiliar format yourself delivers a sharp sense of mastery.

FEATURE 03

1-Bit Pixel Art

Pixel art in just two colors (#222323 · #F0F6F0) creates simple but striking contrast. A monochrome battlefield conveys the urgency and coldness of war.

DESCRIPTION

War In The Dark is a 1-bit turn-based interception simulation set in a fictional 1950s war. Players intercept and interpret enemy Morse signals, then command their allies by sending orders in Morse code. Pixel art in just two colors (#222323 · #F0F6F0) conveys the tension of information warfare.

ABOUT THE STUDIO

Sprout Studio is the indie game studio of solo developer Sijun Kim, who loves plants and games. War In The Dark won the Excellence Award at the Jeonbuk Indie Game Contest and at the Seoul SBA × Supervillain Labs Game Contest, took 2nd place at Play X4 IndieSeed Challenge IR Pitching, and was selected for the Top 20 of the Indiecraft Challenger Division.
